title: Encrypt the tax-id column so a changed row is refused

cases.says: every tax id, the empty one and a long one included, opens back into itself
a stored value with one byte changed is refused with a GeneralSecurityException instead of decrypting to a different tax id
sealing the same tax id six times on one instance gives six different IVs and six different stored values
a second instance with the same key opens values the first one sealed, in any order, so the stored value carries its own IV

origin.section: A GCM IV Used Twice Under One Key Gives Away the XOR of the Two Plaintexts
